lines.ceb: Pamangkin ko sa Dean, ha. Pasagdi na lang ni, dali ra.
lines.en: I'm the Dean's nephew, you know. Just let this through, it's quick.

lines.ceb: Kaila ko sa Registrar. Ayaw na lang ug kuti-kuti, stamp-i na lang.
lines.en: I know the Registrar. Don't nitpick, just stamp it.

lines.ceb: Tawagan nako si Sir Dean kung dili nimo ni i-approve.
lines.en: I'll call the Dean if you don't approve this.

lines.ceb: Palihug. Mawala akong scholarship kung dili ko ma-enroll karon.
lines.en: Please. I'll lose my scholarship if I'm not enrolled today.

lines.ceb: Taga-bukid pa ko, tulo ka sakay ang biyahe. Ayaw na ko pabalika, palihug.
lines.en: I'm from the mountains, it's three rides to get here. Please don't send me back.

lines.ceb: Nasakit akong mama. Kinahanglan ko mahuman ni karon.
lines.en: My mom is sick. I need to get this done today.

lines.ceb: Ania, nagdala ko og puto para nimo. Dali-dali lang ta, ha?
lines.en: Here, I brought you some puto. Let's make this quick, okay?

lines.ceb: Gutom na ka? Naa koy siopao diri. Ikaw na bahala sa akong papeles.
lines.en: Hungry? I've got siopao. I'll leave my papers to you.

lines.ceb: Para nimo ning kape. Stamp-i na lang, ha?
lines.en: This coffee's for you. Just stamp it, okay?
